approvalScope.A_website: Exactly 7 changed files in the Skald site (paths relative to the deploy root, mirrored at mannamila-web skald/): index.html, styles.css, and 5 assets (reader-art.webp, greek-split.webp, museum-guide.webp, nostos-route.webp, skald-odyssey-og-070.jpg). This does NOT authorize copying any other file from the candidate preview tree (work/preview-root or similar), because those are baseline preview dependencies. Body copy is unchanged except the 4 image alt strings, the art figcaption, and the og/twitter image URL+alt. The 0.7.0 upcoming-release notice is retained verbatim, and no EU/UK availability claim is added. The old assets/skald-odyssey-og.jpg stays in place for other routes.
approvalScope.B_ipad_store_panels: Exactly 4 App Store iPad 13-inch panels (2752x2064), re-rendered with the renderer fix that sizes the frame from the EXIF-oriented display dimensions. Captions and raw captures are unchanged. The other 22 production panels must stay byte-identical.

roles.findings: Compared R1 and R2: both independently approve A and B with no required corrections, and bind identical full-length hashes for all 7 web files and 4 iPad panels. Every hash was recomputed from the actual bytes: the deploy/ and source/skald/ mirrors are byte-identical and contain only the 7 files; web-candidate MANIFEST.sha256 and ipad-candidate MANIFEST.sha256 both pass. The index.html diff against the live baseline (0ac01407...) is limited to the og/twitter image URL+alt, the stylesheet key, the 4 figure class hooks, the 4 img src/size/alt, and the art figcaption. Against the reviewed candidate-native-index.html it differs only in the og/twitter lines and the class hooks. The alts and caption match candidate-native-web.json verbatim, and no EU/UK text is present. The 4-asset source mapping matches candidate-native-web.json. The webps are 1320x2868, 2752x2064, 2752x2064, and 1920x1080, and the OG card is 1200x630. The arbiter viewed the OG card (real 03-parallel capture, whole; only the 3 approved lines), the decoded greek-split and museum-guide webps (upright, complete), and iPad panels 01 and 04 (full landscape capture, nothing cropped). The captions.json app-store-ipad entries equal the MANIFEST lines/sub/source for all 4 panels. The prior registry's 4 iPad hashes equal current production and are superseded; the other 22 production panels equal native-panel-hashes.json. The approval rests on existing candidate bytes; no text was rewritten.

priorRegistry.note: The prior approval (gpt-5.6-sol roles) bound the 4 iPad panels that the renderer had cropped: it sized the screen frame from the raw 2064x2752 PNG header and ignored EXIF Orientation=8, so a portrait frame cropped the landscape capture. That approval is retained as history and is superseded only for those 4 entries. Its captions, 22 raw captures, and the other 22 rendered panel hashes remain valid. Do not rewrite or delete the prior record; append or reference this registry.
